    for line in txt.strip().split("\n"):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or "=" not in line:

        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        d[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    return d

import asyncio

async def main():
    r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/start.txt"})
    if not r['ok']:
        return {"stage": "start", "receipt": r}
    start = r['data']['text'].strip()

    chain = []
    detail = []
    path = start
    for _ in range(200):
        rr = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/" + path})
        if not rr['ok']:
            return {"stage": "node", "path": path, "receipt": rr}
        d = {}
        for line in rr['data']['text'].splitlines():
            if '=' in line:
                k, v = line.split('=', 1)
                d[k.strip()] = v.strip()
        val = int(d['value'])
        chain.append((path, val))
        nxt = d['left'] if val % 2 == 0 else d['right']
        detail.append({"path": path, "value": val, "even": val % 2 == 0, "chosen": nxt})
        if nxt == 'END':
            break
        path = nxt

    lines = [p + "\t" + str(v) for p, v in chain]
    total = sum(v for _, v in chain)
    expected = "\n".join(lines + ["TOTAL\t" + str(total)]) + "\n"

    rc = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/chain.tsv"})
    actual = rc['data']['text'] if rc['ok'] else None

    audit_detail = []
    audit_ok = True
    for i, (p, v) in enumerate(chain):
        ap = "/workspace/audit/%02d.txt" % i
        ra = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": ap})
        exp = str(v) + "\n"
        got = ra['data']['text'] if ra['ok'] else None
        good = bool(ra['ok']) and got == exp
        if not good:
            audit_ok = False
        audit_detail.append({"file": ap, "expected": exp, "actual": got, "ok": good})

    rl = await yuki_workspace_list({"path": "/workspace/audit"})
    listing = rl['data'] if rl['ok'] else rl

    return {
        "start": start,
        "n_nodes": len(chain),
        "chain": detail,
        "total": total,
        "expected_text": expected,
        "actual_text": actual,
        "chain_match": actual == expected,
        "audit_count_expected": len(chain),
        "audit_ok": audit_ok,
        "audit_detail": audit_detail,
        "audit_listing": listing,
    }
